defect.description: When pushAfterMerge is enabled, a failed push still finalized the task as done (false SUCCESS).
defect.reproduction: Enable pushAfterMerge; merge succeeds locally; push fails; task column becomes done with pushedToRemote:false.

upstreamComparison.evidence: Upstream documents non-fatal push-after-merge finalize. Appsolino truthfulness invariant forbids DONE when a configured mandatory push final fails.

revisions.summary: Refuse DONE on pushAfterMerge failure; park PUSH_FAILED
